messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — stratus-v1 landed int8 q5 rollout to canary last night + reduced beam size (beam 6 -> 4). Nightly multilingual eval shows regressions in JP/AR/ZN (zh). chrF -1.2 on ja/zh and punctuation/bracket mirroring broken in ar. Anyone on triage?

derek_ml: I saw that too. Nightly dashboard: https://ci.redwood/evals/stratus/1245. Short summary: Japanese: inline brackets lose space and get merged; Arabic: closing bracket appears on wrong side (bidi mirror).

li_zh: Pasting minimal repros. Before (float baseline):
```
src: 彼は (2024年) に訪れました。
ref: He visited in (2024).
hyp_float: He visited in (2024).
```
After (q5-int8 + beam4):
```
hyp_int8: He visited in (twenty twenty four).
```
Japanese also drops narrow-space between ideograph and punctuation in some cases.

yara: Arabic example (note mirroring):
```
src: ثبت (12/03/2024) في السجل.
ref: Registered (12/03/2024) in the record.
hyp_float: Registered (12/03/2024) in the record.
```
After quant+small beam:
```
hyp_int8: Registered )12/03/2024( in the record.
```
Closing paren moved and mirrored.

maria: That parity shift looks like either a tokenization alignment issue (kv-cache offsets) or the quantized logits changing token ranking for narrow punctuation subtokens. Could also be beam size amplifying lower-prob tokens.

derek_ml: Repro steps that hit it reliably for me:
`python -m eval.run --model stratus-v1 --quant q5 --beam 4 --locale ja,ar,zh --dataset i18n-trans --seeds 7,13`
I can repro on canary node gpu-5.

ci-bot: Deployment 501 pushed stratus-v1-q5 (commit f9d2b8) to canary at 02:40 UTC.

maria: Plan: bisect three axes in parallel — 1) quant kernel commit range inside commit f9d2b8, 2) beam change (4->6), 3) kv-cache alignment patch from tokenizer branch. If only beam, revert beam quickly. If quant or kv-cache, we need hotfix.

li_zh: I ran float+beam4 and float+beam6: float+beam4 = ok, float+beam6 = ok. q5+beam6 = problematic, q5+beam4 = problematic. Suggests quant is main contributor.

yara: I'll run token-prop diffs for failing prompts. Use this helper: `python -m eval.token_prop --model stratus-v1 --quant q5 --prompts tests/evals/i18n/stratus_failing.yaml --topk 40 --out artifacts/token_props.json`

derek_ml: Also check softmax numer stability in q5 kernels — previous q4->q5 kernel change included a fix that altered exp max clamp. Might shift logits slightly for low-prob punctuation subtokens.

maria: Action items: maria -> coordinate bisect + decide traffic policy; derek_ml -> run kernel-level logit diffs and softmax regression tests; li_zh -> collect failing set + example pairs; yara -> generate token_prop artifacts and chrF diffs. ops-bot, can we prepare quick routing policy to pin ja/zh/ar routes to float until we have a fix?

ops-bot: Routing change prepared. If requested, can route locales ja,zh,ar to float variants within 12 minutes. Confirm with `ops-bot approve-route stratus-v1 float --locales ja,zh,ar`.

ci-bot: Started job 77321 on ded-node-8 for kernel-compare; job 77322 for token-prop artifacts queued.

li_zh: Note for QA: added failing prompts to `tests/evals/i18n/stratus_failing.yaml` with exact seeds and expected chrF thresholds. Uploading diffs to the eval dashboard now.

derek_ml: Early kernel-compare output: per-token KL divergence spikes for several CJK punctuation subtokens and Arabic mirrored-paren codepoints. Attaching short list in artifacts.

maria: OK. If kernel bisect pins down a specific micro-optimisation, we may revert that small change or add a quant-safe clamping rule. Keep me posted; if we need emergency rollback, I'll request ops-bot route change. Thanks all :rocket:
